अंश: áṃśa, m. (that which one gets, i. e.) one's portion; and so, generalized, portion, part. [√1aś, ‘get.’]
अंशु: aṃśú, m. juicy internodium or shoot of the Soma-plant; and so, shooting ray (of light).
अंशुमत्: aṃśumánt, a. rich in beams, radiant; as m. the sun, 164. [aṃśú, 1235b.]
अंशुमन्त्: aṃśumánt, a. rich in beams, radiant; as m. the sun, 164. [aṃśú, 1235b.]
अंस: áṃsa, m. shoulder. [perhaps, ‘the strong’ (part), √am, 1197a: cf. ὦμ-ος, Lat. um-erus, Goth. amsa, ‘shoulder.’]
अकस्मात्: a-kasmāt, adv. without any “wherefore”; without apparent cause; unexpectedly; accidentally.
अकस्मादागन्तु: akasmād-āgantu, m. an accidental arrival,  a chance comer.
अकार: a-kāra, m. the sound or letter a. [Whitney,  18.]
अकारण: a-kāraṇa, n. lack of cause; -am, adv. causelessly.
अक्तु: aktú, m. 	—1. ointment; 	—2. light, beam of light; 	—3. night. [for 2, cf. ἀκτίς, ‘beam.’]
अक्ष: 1akṣá, n. for akṣán at end of cpds [1315a].
2akṣá, m. a die for playing. [named, perhaps, from its ‘eyes’ (1akṣá) or ‘spots.’]
ákṣa, m. axle. [cf. ἄξων, Lat. axis, AS. eax, Eng. axe (i. e. ‘axle’), and axle.]
अक्षत: á-kṣata, a. unhurt, uninjured; unbroken; as m. pl. unbroken or unhusked grains, esp. of barley.
अक्षतकेसर: akṣata-kesara, a. having an uninjured mane.
अक्षतदेह: akṣata-deha, a. having an unhurt or perfect body.
अक्षन्: akṣán [431], n. eye. [cf. ὔπ-ωπ-α, ‘have seen,’ ὤψ, ‘eye’; ὄσσε, ‘eyes’; Lat. oc-ulus, ‘eye’; the kinship of AS. eāge, Eng. eye, remains to be proved: cf. √īkṣ.]
अक्षप्रिय: akṣa-priya, a. beloved of the dice, i. e. lucky at gaming.
अक्षम: a-kṣama, a. not equal to a thing; unable, w. inf.
अक्षर: a-kṣára, a. imperishable; as n. word; syllable; the sacred syllable, om, 6014; sound, letter, 614.
अक्षरन्यास: akṣara-nyāsa, m. the commitment to letters, the writing.
अक्षारालवण: akṣārālavaṇa, n. that which is not pungent and not salt. [alavaṇa: 1253b.]
अक्षारालवणाशिन्: akṣārālavaṇāśin, a. eating that which is not pungent and not salt, abstaining from seasoned and salted food. [āśin.]
अक्षौहिणीपति: akṣauhiṇī-pati, m. master of an army; general.
अखिल: a-khila, a. without a gap, entire; all.
अगद: a-gadá, a. not having disease, well, healthy, whole; wholesome; as m. medicine.
अग्नि: agní, m. fire; esp. a sacred fire; the god of fire, Agni, mediator between men and gods, messenger who carries the sacrifice to them, protector from the terrors and spirits of darkness, and keeper of house and hearth. [perhaps, ‘the quickly moving or agile one,’ √aj, 1158: cf. Lat. ignis, ‘fire,’ agilis, ‘agile’; akin, poss., is αἴγλη, ‘flashing light.’]
अग्निकुण्ड: agni-kuṇḍa, n. round hole in the ground for the sacred fire.
अग्निवेला: agni-velā, f. fire-hour, time for kindling the sacred fire; afternoon.
अग्निहोत्र: agni-hotrá, n. fire-sacrifice (a burntoffering of fresh milk).
अग्न्याधेय: agny-ādhéya, n. placing or setting up of the sacred fire. [acct, 1272.]
अग्र: ágra, n. 	—1. front; agre, in front, before, in presence of, w. gen.; 	—2. beginning; agre, in the beginning, in the first place, first; 	—3. tip, end. [perhaps, ‘that which goes before, leader,’ √aj: cf. ἄγω, ‘lead,’ στρατ-ηγός, ‘army-leader.’]
अग्रतस्: agratás, adv. in front [1098c8]; before (one's self); w. kṛ, place in front, cause to lead. [agra, 1098b.]
अघ: aghá, a. distressful, harmful; as n. harm, trouble, evil; sin; sorrow. [like aṃhú, ‘narrow,’ and áṃhas, ‘distress,’ from √*aṅgh or aṃh, ‘straiten’: cf. ἄχος, ‘distress’;  ἄγχω, Lat. ango, ‘strangle’; AS. ange, ‘anxious,’ Ger. enge, ‘narrow,’ Angst, ‘distress’: for connection of mgs, cf. Eng. straiten, ‘to narrow’ and ‘to distress.’]
अघ्न्य: á-ghnya, m. bull (the animal that is ‘hard to overcome,’ or more exactly, ‘not to be slain’).
अघ्न्या: ághnyā, f. cow. [formed as a pendant to aghnya.]
अङ्क: aṅká, m. 	—1. the bend at the groin made by taking a sitting position, lap; 	—2. the bend just above the hip (where babes, sitting astride, are carried by Hindu women --see āroha); 	—3. hook; 	—4. (like Eng. pot-hook) mark, sign. [√añc: for 1, cf. ἀγκών, ‘bend in arm or wall or shore’; for 3, cf. ὄγκος, Lat. uncus, AS. ongel, ‘hook’; cf. Eng. angle, not a borrowed word.]
अङ्खय: √aṅkhaya (aṅkháyati [1056, 1067]). hook on, grapple. [from aṅka, ‘hook,’ despite the aspiration.] + pari, clasp, embrace.
अङ्ग: aṅgá, asseverative particle. yád aṅgá, just when; té aṅgá, they only.
áṅga, n. limb, member; by synecdoche, body, person, form. [√aṅg: for mg, cf. aṅgúli, aṅgúṣṭha.]
अङ्गना: aṅganā́, f. a (fair) form, i. e. a woman. [áṅga.]
अङ्गिरस्: áṅgiras, m. 	—1. orig., probably, messenger; esp. messenger between gods and men; by eminence, Agni; 	—2. as pl. Angirases, a name applied by the Hindus to a certain race among their forefathers (perhaps because their intercourse with the gods was conceived as very intimate), these forefathers being regarded as half divine; 	—3. as s. the (mythical) ancestor of the Angirases.
अङ्गुलि: aṅgúli, f. finger. [√aṅg, 1191: for mg, cf. áṅga.]
अङ्गुष्ठ: aṅgúṣṭha, m. thumb. [for mg, cf. áṅga.]
अच्: √ac or añc (ácati, áñcati; akná, añcitá; -ácya). bend. [cf. aṅka and vbl añc.] + ā, bend.
अचर: a-cara, a. not moving; as subst. plant (as distinguished from animals).
अचल: a-cala, a. immovable; as m. mountain.
अचित्: a-cít, a. not knowing; unwise; foolish.
अच्छ: áccha, vbl prefix. to, unto; hither; w. √√ 2naś, yā, vah, vṛt; often acchā, 248a.
अज्: √aj (ájati, -te). drive. [orig. ‘put in motion’: cf. Lat. ago, ‘lead, drive’; ἄγω, ‘lead’: cf. also agra, ajira, āji.] + ud, drive out.
अज: ajá, m. he-goat. [prob. ‘the agile one,’ √aj: cf. αἴξ, ‘goat.’]
अजरामरवत्: ajarāmaravat, adv. as if ageless and immortal. [ajara-amara, 1107, 1257.]
अजस्र: á-jasra, a. not dying out; perpetual (of fire).
अजिन: ajína, m. goat-skin; pelt. [aja: cf. αἰγίς, ‘goat-skin, Aegis,’ w. αἴξ, ‘goat.’]
अजिर: ajirá, a. agile, swift. [√aj, 1188c: cf. Lat. agilis, ‘agile.’]
अज्ञ: a-jña, a. not knowing, ignorant; foolish; as m. fool.
अज्ञात: á-jñāta, a. unknown. [√jñā: cf. ἄ-γνωτος, Lat. i-gnotus, Eng. un-couth, ‘unknown.’]
अज्ञातकुलशील: ajñāta-kulaśīla, a. whose family and character are unknown.
अज्ञान: a-jñāna, n. ignorance; -āt and -atas, out of ignorance.
अञ्च्: añc, as vbl at end of cpds [see 407-9], turning, directed; e. g. úd-añc, directed upward. [for mg, cf. Eng. -ward (in to-ward, etc.), which is akin w. √vṛt, ‘turn.’]
अञ्ज्: √añj or aj (anákti, aṅkté; ānáñja, ānajé [788]; ā́ñjīt; aktá; aktvā́; -áñjya, -ájya). 	—1. smear; anoint; 	—2. adorn. [cf. aktu: cf. Lat. ungo, ‘anoint.’] + ā, anoint. + vi, 	—1. anoint; 	—2. adorn; and so, bring to notice; vyàkta: adorned, fair; manifest;  --caus. make clear or manifest. + sam, 	—1. anoint; 	—2. adorn; 	—3. unite by anointing, 8919; 	—4. generalized, unite with, take to one's self (e. g. food), 8810.
अञ्जलि: añjalí, m. the two hollowed and open hands placed side by side; the hands so placed and raised to the forehead, i. e. a gesture of reverent salutation; a double handful (as measure).
अञ्जस्: áñjas, adv. quickly, suddenly. [prob. adv. acc. or instr. of an obsolete subst. áñjas, ‘a slippery way or a gliding motion,’ √añj.]
अटनी: aṭanī, f. the notched end of a bow.
अण्डज: aṇḍa-ja, a. egg-born; as m. bird.
अतस्: átas, adv. 	—1. (as abl. of pron. root a [1098], and synonymous w. asmāt) from it; so 229, sc. paṅkāt; ato ‘nya, other than it, 6812; 	—2. from this (place), 8315; 	—3. from this (time), 9621; cf. ūrdhvam; then, 4016; 	—4. from this (cause), 3510; therefore, 278, etc.; w. correl. yatas, 363; hence; and so, 394, 4221; so then, 7312. [pron. root a, 502.]
अति: áti, adv. across, beyond, past, over, as vbl prefix; in cpds, to excess, excessive, see 1289b; as prep. beyond, over. [cf. ἔτι, ‘further, besides’; Lat. et, ‘besides, and.’]
अतिक्रम: atikrama, m. act of overstepping or overcoming.  [√kram + ati.]
अतिदूर: ati-dūra, a. very far or distant; as n. great distance.
अतीन्द्रिय: atīndriya, a. transcending the senses; as n. soul, spirit. [ati + indriya, 1310a.]
अत्याज्य: a-tyājya, a. not to be abandoned.
अत्युग्रपुण्यपाप: atyugra-puṇyapāpa, a. extraordinarily good and bad; as n. pl. extraordinarily good and bad deeds.
अत्र: átra (átrā, 248a), adv. 	—1. (as loc. of pron. root a [10994], and synonymous w. asmin) substantively: in it, 9710; in this case, 315; in that case, 1817; on this point, 292; adjectively: w. antare: in this interim, meantime, 2419, 452, 5022, 554; on this occasion, at this juncture, 1911; atra sarasi, in this pool; 	—2. in this or that (place); here, 2516; there, 335, 894; in that world (opp. to ‘in this world’), 871, 7, 9; 	—3. in that (time), then, 5612. [pron. root a, 502.]
अत्रि: átri, m. Atri, name of a famous Rishi.
अथ: átha (áthā, 248a), adv. expresses a sequence, temporal or resultant: then; so; so then; accordingly; thereupon; 	—1. temporal: e. g. áti drava, áthā…úpehi, run past, and then go unto…, 8318; in apodosis after yadā́, 845, 6, 7, 9622; 	—2. resultant: e. g. marúdbhiḥ sakhyáṃ te astu, átha jayāsi, make friends with the Maruts, and then (if thou dost) thou shalt conquer, 822N.; 	—3. very frequent as a simple continuative: now; so; then; usually at beginning of sentence (e. g. 201) or śloka (e. g. 26); sometimes within the śloka (e. g. 314); exceptionally at the end, 139; at beginning of section or book, now, 9816; here beginneth (cf. íti), 11; sometimes much attenuated in meaning; often almost equivalent to a capital letter, to mark the beginning of a new clause, e. g. 9418; connecting parts of sentence, 411; 	—4. pleonastically w. tatas, 139; mere verse-filler, 1019; 	—5. átho, i. e. átha u, and also, 9016; 	—6. serving as a point d'appui for an enclitic, which may thus precede its word: e. g. devo, ‘tha vā yakṣas, a god or a Yaksha, instead of devo, yakṣo vā, 818; so 212; in this use, vā: atha vā:: que: atque; cf. 2721; cf. vā; 	—7. atha vā, or rather, 267N. [pron. root a, 1101, 502; later form of ádhā (which is more common in the Veda): cf. Lat. at, ‘then, further, but.’]
अद्: √ad (átti; atsyáti; áttum). eat; consume. [cf. ἔδω, Lat. edo, AS. etan, Eng. eat: cf. anna.]
ád, vbl. eating, consuming, in cpds.
अदंष्ट्रिन्: a-daṃṣṭrin, a. without tusks or large teeth.
अदन्तजात: a-dantajāta, a. not having teethed. [‘not having grown teeth,’ for a-jātadanta. ]
अदस्: adás [501], pron. yon, yonder, that, that there, in opposition to the one here or just mentioned: e. g. asau, 227, that one (the traveller--last mentioned at 2019); so 3110; asāv amutra, ayam asmin, that one in that world, this one in this, 1037; that one (correl. ya), 76, 3711; as designation of persons not to be named, so-and-so, N. or M.; asāv aham, I am so-and-so, 6114; 6021; 1035; follows at a distance the word to which it refers, thus emphasizing it, 231. [see 501 and 503.]
अदिति: áditi, a. without bond or limit; infinite; as f. infinity, the endless heaven, 7919; infinity,  personified as a goddess, Aditi, 758. [apparently a + *diti, acct, 1304a2: diti, ‘bond,’ would be a reg. deriv. of √3dā, ‘bind,’ but does not occur as such, although there is a word díti, q. v., of quite different mg and origin.]
अदीनात्मन्: adīnātman, a. with cheerful spirit, undaunted.  [ātman.]
अदुर्मङ्गल: á-durmaṅgala, f. -ī, a. bringing no bad luck. [for declension, cf. sumaṅgála, -galī́, and 355b.]
अदृष्टकाम: adṛṣṭa-kāma, m. love for one not yet seen.
अदेव: a-devá, m. non-god, who is no god. [1288a4.]
अद्भुत: ádbhuta, a. wonderful; as n. wonder. [despite anatidbhuta, prob. from at(i)bhūta, ‘transcending what has existed,’ 1310a: cf. ambara.]
अद्य: adyá, adv. to-day; adya niśi, in this night (just past), 518; now; adya yāvat, until now; adya_ārabhya, from now on. [perhaps from *a-dyavi, ‘on this day,’ 1122f, see dyu: cf. Lat. ho-die, ‘to-day.’]
अद्रि: ádri, m. rock; stone; esp. Soma-stone (for bruising the Soma); missile stone.
अद्रिवत्: adrivant, a. having or armed with the hurling-stone.
अद्रिवन्त्: adrivant, a. having or armed with the hurling-stone.
अध: ádha (ádhā, 248a), Vedic adv. expressing a sequence: then, so, 798; so then, 8918; adha yad, just then when, 7614; (then, i. e. besides, i. e.) and, 7718, 786. [11043: cf. átha.]
अधम: adhamá [525], a. lowest; worst. [cf. adhas and 474: cf. Lat. infimus, ‘lowest.’]
अधर: ádhara [525], a. lower. [cf. adhas and 474: cf. Lat. inferus, ‘lower’; Eng. under.]
अधःशायिन्: adhaḥ-śāyin, a. lying low, i. e. sleeping on the ground.
अधस्तात्: adhástāt, adv. below; as prep., w. gen. [1130], under. [adhas, 1100b.]
अधि: ádhi, adv. over, besides, in addition, 9616; as prep. above, over, on; w. instr. (of snú only), away over, 7911; w. abl. from, out of, 1034; w. loc.: over, 907; on, 7013, 9211.
अधिक: adhika, a. (like Eng. over in adj. uses) additional;  surpassing the usual measure, superior, extraordinary; as n. surplus. [ádhi, 1222a.]
अधिकरूपवत्: adhika-rūpavant, a. surpassingly or most beautiful.
अधिकरूपवन्त्: adhika-rūpavant, a. surpassingly or most beautiful.
अधिकानुराग: adhikānurāga, m. superior affection or most affection. [anurāga.]
अधिकार: adhikāra, m. authority; office; duties of office. [√1kṛ + adhi, ‘put over or in office.’]
अधिज्य: ádhijya, a. having the bow-string up or on, i. e. strung. [2jyā́, 1305.]
अधिष्ठान: adhiṣṭhā́na, n. standing-place; (of the soul) a dwelling-place or manifestation. [√sthā + adhi.]
अधोनिवीत: adho-nivīta, a. having the sacred cord (worn) low. [adhas.]
अध्ययन: adhyayana, n. reading; study, esp. of the Veda. [√i + adhi, 1150. 1a.]
अध्याय: adhyāya, m. reading; study, esp. of the Veda; (like Eng. lesson), lectio, chapter, 5616, 5815, etc. [√i + adhi, 1148. 2.]
अध्वर: adhvará, m. religious or liturgical service;  sacrifice, esp. Soma-sacrifice.
अध्वर्यु: adhvaryú, m. priest, who did the actual work of the sacrifice, and appears in the oldest period as companion of the hotṛ--see ṛtvij. [√adhvarya, 1178h.]
अन्: an, before consonants a, negative prefix. [1121a; acct, 1288a, 1304a: cf. ἀν-, ἀ-, Lat. in-, Eng. un-.]
√an (ániti [631]; ā́na; ā́niṣus; aniṣyáti; anitá; ánitum; -ánya). breathe, blow; live. [cf. anila, ἄνεμος, Lat. anima, ‘current of air’; Goth. an-an, ‘breathe.’] + pra, breathe.
अनन्तर: an-antará, 	—1. a. having no interval; immediately adjoining; -am, adv. immediately afterwards, afterwards; thereupon; 	—2. as n. non-interval, in sam-.
अनमीव: an-amīvá, a. without sickness or trouble, well; as n. weal. [ámīvā, 1304a.]
अनर्घ्य: an-arghya, a. not to be priced, priceless.
अनवद्य: an-avadyá, a. not un-praiseworthy; blameless, faultless.
अनवद्याङ्ग: anavadyāṅga, f. -ī, a. having a faultless body. [áṅga.]
अनवेक्ष: an-avekṣa, a. without any looking around; -am, adv. without looking around. [avekṣā.]
अनवेक्षमाण: an-avekṣamāṇa, a. not looking around. [√īkṣ + ava.]
अनष्टपशु: ánaṣṭa-paśu, a. who loses nothing from his herd. [prop. ‘having a not lost herd.’]
अनस्: ánas, n. cart for heavy burden. [cf. Lat. onus, ‘burden.’]
अनागत: án-āgata, a. not arrived; not (yet) come, impending, future. [√gam + ā.]
अनागतवत्: anāgatavant, a. having to do with the future. [1233.]
अनागतवन्त्: anāgatavant, a. having to do with the future. [1233.]
अनागतविधातृ: anāgata-vidhātṛ, m. arranger for the future; Forethought, name of a fish.
अनामय: an-āmayá, a. without disease, healthy; as n. health.
अनारुह्य: an-āruhya, grd. without going into (danger). [√ruh + ā.]
अनिविशमान: á-niviśamāna, a. not going to rest. [acct, 1283.]
अनिवेशन: a-niveśaná, a. having no resting-place, unsettled. [nivéśana, 1304a.]
अनिष्ट: an-iṣṭa, a. undesired; disagreeable; unapproved,  unlawful. [√1iṣ.]
अनिष्टचिन्तन: aniṣṭa-cintana, n. the thinking about something unlawful.
अनीक: ánīka, n. 	—1. face; 	—2. fig. appearance; 	—3. of a hatchet (face, i. e.), sharp edge; 	—4. front, and so, by synecdoche, troop. [so Lat. acies has mgs 3 and 4.]
अनीतिज्ञ: a-nītijña, a. not knowing discreet conduct.
अनु: ánu, prep. after, along, toward; w. acc. along or over; after, i. e. according to.
अनुगति: anugati, f. a going after. [√gam + anu.]
अनुचर: anucará, a. going after; as m. attendant; companion. [√car + anu.]
अनुजीविन्: anu-jīvin, a. living upon, dependent; as m. a dependent. [√jīv + anu.]
अनुत्त: á-nutta, a. un-moved, i. e. invincible. [√nud.]
अनुत्तम: anuttama, a. most highest; best, most excellent; supreme. [lit. ‘most best,’ formal superl. to anuttara, which is itself logically a superl.]
अनुत्तर: an-uttara, a. not having a superior, i. e. best. [for mg, cf. niḥśreyasa.]
अनुपकारिन्: an-upakārin, a. not doing or unable to do a friendly service.
अनुपूर्व: anu-pūrva, a. following the one preceding,  one after another; -ám, adv. in regular order. [1310a.]
अनुमति: ánumati, f. approbation; favor (of gods to the pious); personified, Grace. [√man + anu.]
अनुमान: anumāna, n. the forming of a conception. [√1mā + anu, ‘conceive.’]
अनुरोधिन्: anurodhin, a. having (some) regard for. [√1rudh + anu.]
अनुल्बण: an-ulbaṇá, a. not lumpy; smooth or perfect (of a weft). [1288a4.]
अनुवृत्ति: anuvṛtti, f. sequence, and so, continuance.  [√vṛt + anu.]
अनुव्रत: ánu-vrata, a. acting according to the will or command (of another), obedient; devoted to, w. acc. [272], 616, 1004. [1310a: cf. apavrata.]
अनुशय: anuśaya, m. repentance. [perhaps ‘that which lies down after one or follows one to his bed’: √śī + anu.]
अनुष्ठान: anuṣṭhāna, n. devotion to, observance. [√sthā + anu.]
अनुष्ठेय: anuṣṭheya, grdv. to be accomplished. [see √sthā + anu, and 963a.]
अनुसरण: anusaraṇa, n. a going after, a searching. [√sṛ + anu.]
अनुस्तरण: anustaraṇa, a. strewing over, covering over; --f. anustáraṇī (sc. go), a cow, slaughtered at the funeral ceremony, and the pieces of which are used for covering over the corpse, limb by limb. [√stṛ + anu.]

अपव्रत: ápa-vrata, a. disobedient; stubborn. [‘away from command,’ 1310a: cf. ánuvrata. ]

अपि: ápi, indecl. unto, close upon or on; 	—1. prep. to, w. √gam; 	—2. adv. (thereto, besides,  i. e.) further, also; connecting clauses (6323) or words (6511); connecting sentences, api ca, and besides, 299, see ca 3; …api …api, both…and, 5423; …, …ca api, and, 512, 265; …ca, …cāpi, both…and also, 121; …, …caiva, …cāpi, 6515; …cāpi, …ca, 321, 1611; …cāpi, …ca, …ca, 166, 6010; na…, na_api…, neither…, nor…, 99; na…, na cāpi, 2212; na…, na…, …api ca, neither…, nor…, nor also…, 212;…, …vā, …vā_api, either…, or…, or even…, 622; 	—3. also, too, immediately following the emphasized word, 612, 113, 2118, 2421; mām api, me too, 4120; 	—4. even, immediately following the emphasized word, and often marking a circumstance under which a thing is true where this is not to be expected: e. g. 213, 287, 18, 3319; tathā_api, so even, i. e. nevertheless, 2111; concessively, although, 291, 2114, 511, 5; w. na, not even, 1915; w. indefinites, kadā cid api na, not ever at all, 3114, 323; 	—5. but, immediately following a new subject, after change of subject, 615, 2821, 3222, 4117, 20, 21; 	—6. at least, 289, 11; 	—7. converts an interr. into an indef. अप्रज: á-praja, a. having no offspring, childless. [prajā, 367b.]
अप्रज्ञात: a-prajñāta, a. undistinguished or not clearly to be known. [√jñā.]
अप्रतिम: a-pratima, a. without match or equal; unequalled. [pratimā, 367b.]

अप्रिय: á-priya, a. not dear; disliked; disagreeable.

अविप्लुत: a-vipluta, a. not dishonored; unsullied. [√plu + vi, q. v.]
अविषय: a-viṣaya, m. a non-province; something out of one's line or that one has no business to do; unlawful thing.
अवृक: a-vṛká, a. not harmful; -ám, adv. harmlessly,  lovingly. [vṛ́ka: acct, 1288a4.]
अवेक्षा: avekṣā, f. a looking around. [√īkṣ + ava, 11493.]
अव्यक्त: a-vyakta, a. not manifest; as m. The All-soul, 6717. [√añj.]
अव्यय: a-vyaya, a. imperishable; not subject to change; unbroken. [1288a.]
अश्: √1aś, orig. aṃś (aśnóti, aśnuté; ānáṃśa, ānaśé [7884]; ā́ṣṭa; aṣṭá; áśitum). reach; attain; obtain, get. [cf. ποδ-ηνεκ-ής, ‘reaching to the feet’; ἤν-εγκ-α, ‘carried’: see also the closely related √2naś.] + upa, attain to.
√2aś (aśnā́ti; ā́śa; ā́śīt; aśiṣyáti; aśitá; áśitum; aśitvā́; -áśya). partake of; taste; eat. [a specialization of √1aś: cf. ἄκ-ολος, ‘bit’: for mg, cf. bhakṣ.] + pra, partake of; caus. feed.
अशङ्क: a-śaṅka, a. without hesitation. [śaṅkā: cf. aviśaṅka.]
अशेव: á-śeva, a. not dear; hostile. [śéva: acct, 1288a.]
अशेष: a-śeṣa, a. without remainder, entire; -tas, adv. entirely, without exception.
अश्मन्: áśman, m. 	—1. stone; 	—2. thunderbolt; 	—3. vault of heaven, 799. [cf. ἄκμων, ‘anvil, thunderbolt’; kinship w. Eng. hammer uncertain.]
अश्व: áśva, m. horse; áśvā, f. mare, steed. [cf. ἵππος, dialectic ἵκκος, Lat. equus, Old Saxon ëhu, AS. eh, eoh, ‘horse.’]
अश्वकोविद: aśva-kovida, a. well skilled in horses.
अश्विन्: aśvín, a. horsed; as dual m. the Aśvins, gods of the morning light, 8515N. [aśva.]
अश्व्य: áśvya, a. consisting of horses; of a horse. [aśva: cf. ἵππιος, ‘of a horse.’]
अष्ट: aṣṭá [4833], num. eight. [cf. ὀκτώ, Lat. octō, AS. eahta, Eng. eight.]
अष्टविध: aṣṭa-vidha, a. of eight sorts; eight-fold. [vidhā, 1302c 5.]
अष्टाङ्गपात: aṣṭāṅga-pāta, m. a fall on eight members,  i. e. on hands, knees, feet, breast, and face, i. e. a most profound obeisance.
अस्: √1as (ásti [636]; ā́sa). 	—1. be, exist; be present or on hand; take place, happen; asti, āsīt, there is, there was, very frequent at beg. of stories; 	—2. be, w. predicate possessive gen., i. e. belong to; asti mama, I have; observe that Skt. has no verb for ‘have’; 	—3. most frequent as simple copula; further, w. ppls: e. g. prāpto ‘si, art thou come, didst thou come, 91; hantavyo 'smi, occidendus sum, 32; śepāno 'smi, I have sworn, 977; redundantly [303b4 end]: e. g. tathā_anuṣṭhite sati, it being thus performed,  3517; so 3713, 3916, 22; prahṛṣṭaḥ san, being pleased, 4812; 	—4. w. advs: tūṣṇīm āsīt, kept silent; evam astu, so be it; w. prādus, see s. v.; 	—5. become, 9619. [w. ás-ti, s-ánti, ‘is, are,’ cf. ἔσ-τι, ‘ís, exists,’ εἰσί, Doric ἐντί, *ἅντι, ‘are,’ Lat. es-t, s-unt, AS. is, *is-t, s-ind, ‘is, are,’ Eng. is; cognate are a-m, ar-t, are.]

√2as (ásyati, -te; ā́sa; asiṣyáti; astá; ásitum; asitvā́; -ásya). throw, cast, shoot; throw aside. [cf. así, ‘the brandished’ sword; Lat. ensis, ‘sword’; ālea, *aslea, ‘die,’ like Ger. Würfel, ‘die,’ fr. werfen, ‘throw.’] + vy-ati, throw over, cross. + abhi, throw (one's self) upon, direct (one's attention) to, study. [for mg, cf. προσέχειν without τὸν νοῦν.] + ni, throw down; deposit; commit. + pari-ni, throw down over, stretch over. + nis, throw out; root out; destroy. + vi, 	—1. cast asunder; cast or throw away; 	—2. break in pieces, 7014. + sam, cast or put together.
असंह्रादयन्त्: a-saṃhrādayant, a. not causing to rattle. [√hrād.]
असत्: á-sant, a. non-existing; as n. non-existence.
असन्त्: á-sant, a. non-existing; as n. non-existence.
असपिण्ड: a-sapiṇḍa, a. related more distantly than in the sixth generation, see sapiṇḍa.
असम्बद्ध: a-sambaddha, a. un-connected, in-coherent,  w. same fig. mg as in Eng. [√bandh.]
असु: ásu, m. vital spirit; vigorous life. [√1as.]
असुनीति: ásu-nīti, f. the leading or continuing of life (in the other world); spirit-life; spirit-world.  [acct, 1274.]
असुन्व: a-sunvá, a. not pressing (Soma), i. e. indifferent to the gods, godless. [see 1148. 3b and 716.]
असुर: ásura, 	—1. a. spiritual (used of the gods, and designating esp. the difference between celestial and mundane existence); 	—2. as m. a spirit of life, a god; ásura adevá, spirit that is no god, demon, 826; 	—3. later, demon (456), enemy of the gods, an Asura, a not-god (as if the word were a-sura--whence, by popular etymology,  the pendant sura, ‘god’). [asura, 1226 (cf. 1188f), and as-u fr. √1as, 1178b.]
असुर्य: asuryà, a. godlike; as n. pl. godhead. [ásura, 1212d 4.]
अस्त: ásta, n. home; ástam, w. i, gam, yā, go home; esp. of the sun [see 1092b], set. [prob. √1as: for mg, cf. bhavana.]
अस्तमौन: asta-mauna, a. having thrown aside or abandoned silence. [√2as.]
अस्थन्: asthán [431], n. bone. [cf. ὀστέον, Lat. stem ossi-, *osti-, nom. os, ‘bone.’]
अस्म: asmá [494], pron. stem. we, us. [cf. ἡμεῖς, Lesbian ἄμμες, ‘we.’]
अस्मद्: asmád, as stem in cpds [494], our; as pl. majestaticus, my.
अस्वस्थ: a-svastha, a. not well, ill; not self-contained,  not master of one's self.
अह्: √ah (ā́ttha, ā́ha, āháthus, -tus, āhús [801a]). say; call; āhus, they say. [cf. Lat. aio, ‘say,’ ad-ag-ium, ‘saw, proverb,’ nego, ‘say no.’] + pra, declare to be.
अह: 1áha, assev. particle. certainly, of course; namely. [pron. root a: cf. 11043 end.]
अहत: á-hata, a. 	—1. not beaten; 	—2. (since Hindu washermen wet the clothes and pound them with stones) unwashed, of a garment, i. e. new. [√han.]
अहन्: áhan, áhar, áhas [430a], n. day (as opp. to night), e. g. 9216; day.
अहम्: ahám [491], pron. I. [cf. ἐγώ, Lat. ego, AS. ic, Eng. I: see 491 and ma etc.]
अहर्निश: ahar-niśa, n. day and night, νυχθήμερον; -am, adv. constantly. [niśā: 1253b.]
अहह: ahaha, excl. of joy or sorrow. [1135a.]
अहार्य: a-hārya, a. not liable to be stolen.
अहार्यत्व: ahāryatva, n. non-liability to be stolen. [1239.]
अहि: áhi, m. serpent; esp. the dragon of the sky, often identified w. the demon Vritra. [see under agha: cf. ἔχις, Lat. anguis, ‘serpent’;  ἔγχελυς, Lat. anguilla, ‘cel.’]
अहिगोपा: áhi-gopā [352], a. having the dragon as their keeper. [13021.]
अहिहत्य: ahi-hátya, n. the slaying of the dragon; the (victorious) fight with the dragon. [acct, 1272a, 1213c.]
अहो: aho, excl. of astonishment, pleasant or unpleasant. [1135a: euphony, 138f.]
अहोरात्र: aho-rātrá, n. day and night, νυχθήμερον. [áhas + rā́tri, 1253b: see rātra.]
